CustomField.label: Action URL
CustomField.description: Optional destination displayed as an action link when this Check fails. Link to a Salesforce record, edit or create page, related list, report, Knowledge article, or HTTPS playbook. Current-record merge tokens are resolved before display and may traverse relationships, for example {!record.Id} or {!record.Owner.ManagerId}. Blank, unsafe, or overlong resolved URLs are hidden. Action Label is optional and defaults to "Fix this".
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional failure-action destination. Use a same-org path or HTTPS URL; {!record.FieldName} merge tokens are supported. Action Label is optional.
